ns2:course.label: ECE Social Studies Content and Methods
ns2:course.description: Focuses on the content and instruction of social studies concepts for grades PreK – 2. Instructional strategies, planning and assessment through an inquiry model of instruction will be emphasized. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: For students in the Early Childhood Professional Education concentration.
